no-restricted-properties.message: Don't read mc.pcts directly — a Monte Carlo dollar figure read outside selectPortfolioAtAge() is how three tabs ended up disagreeing on the same number (see CLAUDE.md rule 8, src/noRawMcAccess.test.js). Use selectPortfolioAtAge(mc, age, opts) instead. Genuine exception (array-wide scan, handing the raw array to FanChart, or reading structural metadata like [0]?.age rather than a dollar value)? Add // eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-properties with a comment explaining why, and add the same line to noRawMcAccess.test.js's ALLOWED list.
Same rule as mc.pcts — stress is a runMC result too. See the mc.pcts message.

Don't read mc.term directly — it's a separate aggregate from mc.pcts that can silently disagree with it (see the runMC padding fix in CLAUDE.md / App.jsx). Use selectPortfolioAtAge(mc, age, opts) instead, which reads the same terminal figure through mc.pcts. Genuine exception (a permanent point-in-time snapshot, not a live display)? Add // eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-properties with a comment explaining why.
